[About]{.kicker}

# Practice in public {.unnumbered .unlisted}

TidyTuesday is a weekly social data project run by the R for Data Science community. A new dataset appears every Tuesday, and anyone can make something with it and share it. This site collects what I made.
:::

## Why I do it

I'm [Arun Koundinya Parasa](https://arunkoundinya.github.io/), and I work with data for a living. Work rarely gives you a fresh dataset and an open brief every week, so TidyTuesday is where I practise: a new subject each time, a deadline that doesn't matter, and nobody telling me which chart to make.

The early weeks are simple line and column charts in Python with `plotnine`. Later ones move to R and `ggplot2` for things that need more control: custom backgrounds, annotated recreations of W.E.B. Du Bois's plates, choropleth maps with `sf`, a racing bar chart with `gganimate`, and a Quarto dashboard.

## How each analysis is built

- **Python weeks** run inside the page. The code you see is the code that drew the chart, rendered with Quarto and Jupyter.
- **R weeks** were built in R scripts and saved as images; the page shows the full script, folded, next to each chart.
- Every page links to the TidyTuesday readme for its dataset, so you can start from the same data.

## Reuse the code

All of it is on [GitHub](https://github.com/ArunKoundinya/TidyTuesday). Copy anything you find useful; a link back is appreciated. Comments are open at the bottom of each analysis if you spot a mistake or have a better idea.
